meta.name: apollo-core-workflow-a
meta.description:
Implement Apollo.io lead search and enrichment workflow.
Use when building lead generation features, searching for contacts,
or enriching prospect data from Apollo.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo lead search", "search apollo contacts",
"find leads in apollo", "apollo people search", "enrich contacts apollo".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给销售团队做客户挖掘和资料补全
copy.tagline_en: Search and enrich Apollo.io sales leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building sales prospecting features

howto.what: 装好后,当你要求搜索潜在客户时,Claude 会按 Apollo.io 流程进行联系人搜索、补全公司资料和联系人邮箱,并生成带评分的潜在客户名单。它还会处理搜索无结果、缺邮箱等常见错误。
howto.when: 当你说出「apollo lead search」「search apollo contacts」等关键词,或要求搜索 Apollo 联系人、补全潜在客户数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 Apollo 里做 SaaS 销售的潜在客户
say.note: 按条件搜索并返回分页的联系人列表。

say.text: 把这些公司的资料和邮箱补全
say.note: 补全公司信息和邮箱,缺失时提示。

say.text: 用 Apollo 找线索,按评分排序给我
say.note: 生成带评分的潜在客户名单。

howto.what_en: After setup, when asked to find prospects, Claude runs the Apollo.io lead-search flow: paginated people results, enriched data with emails, scored lead pipeline. Handles empty results, missing emails, rate limits, invalid domains.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "apollo lead search", "search apollo contacts", or ask to search Apollo contacts / enrich prospect data.

say_en.text: Search Apollo for SaaS sales prospects for me.
say_en.note: Returns paginated people results matching the criteria.

say_en.text: Enrich these companies' data and emails.
say_en.note: Fills in company info and emails; flags missing ones.

say_en.text: Find Apollo leads and rank them for me.
say_en.note: Generates a scored list of candidate leads.
